extension.news:
[B]3.0.0[/B] - Update to modern stack: tulip 4.x, urldispatcher, netclient, unicache, fuzzywuzzy - Kodi 19-21+ Python 3 support (xbmc.python 3.0.0) - Support for redesigned website (fashiontv.com) - Direct 1080p FHD live stream (FashionTV Paris L'Original) - Direct CDN streams without SSAI ad-injection wrapper - Fix FashionTV Asia YouTube channel mapping - Fix duration and live flag parsing - Add Country Highlights directory
[B]2.0.X[/B] - Update for new website design - Add search function - Add shortcut to live channels - New YouTube API keys
[B]1.3.X[/B] - Change cache method - Place youtube channels on submenu - Change main label from "Live" to "Fashion TV Live" - Remove check for inputstream addon
[B]1.2.0[/B] - Update youtube api keys - Rework of router scheme - Tweaks for Matrix
[B]1.1.0[/B] - Add bookmarking feature
[B]1.0.3[/B] - Added FTV news channel
[B]1.0.2[/B] - Re-addition of previously unsupported streams - Properly check for stream m3u8/mpd and dash activation
[B]1.0.1[/B] - Removed unsupported streams - Check if Kodi Leia+ for asking about inputstream addon
